```{r}
#| label: setup
library(gRate)
plate <- readRDS(params$plate_rds)
```

## Plate overview

```{r}
print(plate)
```

```{r}
#| label: plate-map
gr_plot_plate(plate, "max_od")
```

## Quality control

```{r}
#| label: qc-summary
#| results: asis
if (is.null(plate$qc)) {
  cat("QC has not been run on this plate (`gr_qc()`).\n")
} else {
  flagged <- subset(plate$qc, flagged)
  if (nrow(flagged) == 0) {
    cat("All wells pass QC.\n")
  } else {
    knitr::kable(
      flagged[c("well", "reasons")],
      caption = sprintf("%d flagged well(s)", nrow(flagged)),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: qc-map
#| eval: !expr "!is.null(plate$qc)"
gr_plot_plate(plate, "flagged")
```

```{r}
#| label: qc-thresholds
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(plate$qc)) {
  th <- attr(plate$qc, "thresholds")
  th$checks <- paste(th$checks, collapse = ", ")
  cat("Thresholds used:\n\n")
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(parameter = names(th), value = unlist(lapply(th, format))),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Growth curves

Flagged wells are highlighted in orange.

```{r}
#| label: curves
#| fig-height: 7
gr_plot_curves(plate)
```

## Growth parameters

```{r}
#| label: fit-summary
#| results: asis
if (is.null(plate$fit)) {
  cat("Growth models were not fitted (`gr_fit()`).\n")
} else {
  ok <- plate$fit[plate$fit$fit_ok, ]
  cat(sprintf(
    "Method: **%s**; %d/%d wells fitted successfully.\n\n",
    plate$meta$fit_method, nrow(ok), nrow(plate$fit)
  ))
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(
      parameter = c("r (growth rate)", "K (carrying capacity)",
                    "lag time", "doubling time"),
      median = signif(c(median(ok$r), median(ok$K),
                        median(ok$lag), median(ok$doubling_time)), 3),
      min = signif(c(min(ok$r), min(ok$K),
                     min(ok$lag), min(ok$doubling_time)), 3),
      max = signif(c(max(ok$r), max(ok$K),
                     max(ok$lag), max(ok$doubling_time)), 3)
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-map
#| eval: !expr "!is.null(plate$fit)"
gr_plot_plate(plate, "r")
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-failed
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(plate$fit) && any(!plate$fit$fit_ok)) {
  failed <- plate$fit[!plate$fit$fit_ok, ]
  knitr::kable(
    failed[c("well", "note")],
    caption = sprintf("%d well(s) could not be fitted", nrow(failed)),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Spatial correction

```{r}
#| label: spatial
#| results: asis
if (is.null(plate$spatial)) {
  cat("Spatial effects were not estimated (`gr_spatial()`).\n")
} else {
  sp <- plate$spatial
  cat(sprintf(
    "Row/column effects estimated on **%s** by median polish; curves %s.\n\n",
    sp$stat,
    if (isTRUE(sp$corrected)) "were corrected multiplicatively"
    else "were **not** corrected"
  ))
  print(knitr::kable(
    data.frame(row = names(sp$row_effects),
               effect = round(sp$row_effects, 3)),
    caption = "Row effects (1 = no bias)", row.names = FALSE
  ))
  print(knitr::kable(
    data.frame(col = names(sp$col_effects),
               effect = round(sp$col_effects, 3)),
    caption = "Column effects (1 = no bias)", row.names = FALSE
  ))
}
```
